children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may bounce into a range of 4,964-4,985 ringgit per metric ton, following its stabilization around a support at 4,876 ringgit.
The stabilization indicates the formation of a bullish wedge, the upper trendline of which points at a target of 5,018 ringgit.

Increasing the likelihood of a bounce is the possible completion of a wave c from 5,018 ringgit. Considering that the market has climbed above resistance at 4,930 ringgit, it may test the next one at 4,964 ringgit.
Immediate support is at 4,903 ringgit, a break below which may trigger a fall into the 4,843-4,876 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the uptrend is considered steady within a rising channel.
A break below support at 4,897 ringgit would trigger a drop toward 4,814 ringgit. Such a drop would be deep enough to signal a reversal of the uptrend from 4,462 ringgit.
